title: Red Hat Security Advisory: OpenShift Container Platform 4.19.55 bug fix and security update
description: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.19.55 includes critical security updates addressing two vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-98432, a kernel IPv4 issue involving freeing inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period, and CVE-2026-111497, an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Google Brotli decoder. Users of OpenShift Container Platform 4.19 are advised to upgrade to this release to mitigate these issues. Detailed upgrade instructions and release notes are provided by Red Hat.
